sentences.l2: 近年来，汉服作为一种承载着深厚历史记忆的传统服饰，正以前所未有的姿态重返都市青年的日常生活。
sentences.l1: In recent years, Hanfu, as a kind of traditional clothing carrying deep historical memory, is returning to the daily lives of urban young people in an unprecedented manner.

sentences.l2: 它不再是博物馆橱窗里僵硬的陈列品，也不是影视剧中虚构的想象，而是被年轻人主动穿进地铁、校园与咖啡馆的鲜活存在。
sentences.l1: It is no longer a stiff exhibit in a museum display window, nor an imagined fiction in film and television dramas, but a vivid presence that young people actively wear onto the subway, onto campuses, and into cafes.

sentences.l2: 每逢传统佳节，城市公园与古镇街区便聚满了身着襦裙、马面裙的年轻人，他们精心打理发髻、执扇而立，只为在镜头前留下属于自己的东方剪影；这些照片经由社交平台不断传播，又迅速转化为一股不可忽视的国潮风潮。
sentences.l1: Whenever a traditional festival comes, city parks and ancient town streets fill up with young people in ruqun and horse-face skirts, who carefully arrange their hair buns and stand holding fans, just to leave an Eastern silhouette of their own in front of the camera; these photos, spread continually through social platforms, quickly turn into a national-trend wave that cannot be ignored.

sentences.l2: 这种复兴并非简单的复古模仿。
sentences.l1: This revival is not simple retro imitation.

sentences.l2: 许多设计者在保留传统形制与纹样的同时，融入现代剪裁与日常化的面料，使宽袍大袖也能适应快节奏的都市生活。
sentences.l1: Many designers, while retaining traditional forms and patterns, incorporate modern tailoring and everyday fabrics, so that wide robes and big sleeves can also adapt to fast-paced urban life.

sentences.l2: 而在更深层的意义上，年轻人对汉服的偏爱，实则是一种文化认同的自觉表达。
sentences.l1: And at a deeper level, young people's fondness for Hanfu is in fact a conscious expression of cultural identity.

sentences.l2: 他们借由一针一线的仪式感，重新确认自己从何而来。
sentences.l1: Through the sense of ritual in every stitch, they reconfirm where they come from.
